Chapter 856: Chapter 4: Lin Yuan in the River of Time (Please Subscribe)_2

However, Lin Yuan possessed the comprehension of the Sixth Realm in time-space. Through the transferred time-space fluctuations, he could faintly reproduce the deep time-space of the distant past where several mighty beings controlled time-space to integrate and refine a vast secret realm.

“I also possess the comprehension of the Sixth Realm in time-space, but compared to the true Level Twelve Ultimate, I still lack a lot.”

At this moment, Lin Yuan also realized this.

Although his comprehension of time-space was the same as that of Level Twelve mighty beings, the foundation of his power was far too different.

For blades of the same quality and standard, one wielded by a hundred pounds of force and the other by a hundred tons of force.

The destructive power and potency caused, naturally, aren’t of the same level.

“Take it slowly.”

“How long have I been cultivating?”

Although Lin Yuan craved the Path Splitting Realm and Level Twelve, he also knew that accumulation was the key for his current self.

Even though Lin Yuan could already try to break through to Ultimate anytime, and his hope of stepping into Level Twelve was much greater than any Level Eleven Perfected Evolver, and by a considerable margin at that.

But Lin Yuan would still not rush into it recklessly.

Once he began to break through to the Ultimate, there would be absolutely no way back—he would either succeed in stepping into Level Twelve or be erased by the backlash in the River of Time.

Lin Yuan didn’t know if the Myriad Realms Gate could save his life, but he naturally had to prepare for the worst.

“The time for the Level Eleven celebration will be set in a month.”

Apart from cultivating and comprehending Dao, Lin Yuan also received numerous congratulatory messages, all celebrating his advancement to Level Eleven.

Every newly promoted Level Eleven has to hold a celebration to awe the foreign races; Nalan, when he stepped into Level Eleven, did the same.

As a member of human civilization, Lin Yuan naturally could not break this convention.

After all, holding a celebration had substantial benefits for Lin Yuan, which were the numerous congratulatory gifts.

Hundreds of years ago, when Lin Yuan held his Level Ten celebration, he received several millions worth of Cubic Universe Crystals from various forces.

Millions of Cubic Universe Crystals, for Lin Yuan now, naturally weren’t significant, but keep in mind, this was only the gift money from the Level Ten celebration.

Compared to Lin Yuan who had just stepped into Level Ten, millions of Cubic Universe Crystals were already a substantial amount.

And now.

Lin Yuan stepping into Level Eleven, the celebration he would hold for Level Eleven would definitely surpass the scale, prestige, and number of congratulating forces and gift money of the Level Ten celebration.

These ceremonial gift monies, for Lin Yuan who was worried about the vast resources needed to cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique, were like timely help in the snow.

Even if these still couldn’t fill all the resources needed to cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique to Level Eleven Perfect, they at least eased some of Lin Yuan’s pressure.

The Level Eleven celebration held by Lin Yuan, no matter from which aspect, far surpassed the one held by Nalan’s deputy tower master.

There was no alternative.

Although both Lin Yuan and Nalan’s deputy tower master held Level Eleven celebrations, the significance the two represented was completely different.

The many forces of human civilization might be able to ignore Nalan’s deputy tower master, but they dare not offend the Galaxy Master in the slightest.

Nalan, stepping into Level Eleven, his ultimate upper limit is merely Level Eleven Perfect, with a very slight chance of stepping into Level Twelve.

But for the Galaxy Master, there is hope of stepping into Level Twelve.

Once the Galaxy Master becomes one of the twelve mighty beings of human civilization in the future.

Then those forces that didn’t come to congratulate today, or say, those families who didn’t send enough gift money, would probably regret it immensely.

Instead of regretting it later, better to make things satisfactory now.

This was the thought process of all the major forces of human civilization.

Therefore leading to—

The total amount of gift money received by Lin Yuan for this Level Eleven celebration reached—

“3.2 billion Cubic Universe Crystals?”

Lin Yuan counted the total amount of gift money received, a smile appearing on his face.

3.2 billion Cubic Universe Crystals, probably comparable to the entire net worth of many ordinary Level Eleven Evolvers.

Such a huge amount of Universe Crystals, exchanged for various resources, with the discounts enjoyed by Lin Yuan as a high-level citizen, could probably push the cultivation progress of the Xuanhuang Physique significantly forward.

“3.2 billion Universe Crystals, plus the Universe Crystals I’ve saved up over the years, perhaps I can cultivate the Xuanhuang Physique to a significant completion at Level Eleven?”

Lin Yuan estimated in his heart.

The cultivation of the Xuanhuang Physique is mainly limited by two aspects, one is the availability of Xuanhuang Crystals, which Lin Yuan did not lack.

The Xuanhuang Crystal accumulated over the years in the Xuanhuang Secret Realm is completely sufficient, and there are so many Xuanhuang Beasts, continuously giving birth to new Xuanhuang Crystals.

Thus, the main shackles restricting Lin Yuan’s cultivation of the Xuanhuang Physique are resources.

…

Time passes.

In the blink of an eye, three months had passed.

Milky Way Main Star.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, the flashes of insight continuously emerging in his mind pushing the advancement of his rule realms.

“Great Destruction Rule, finally reached the Seventh Realm…”

Lin Yuan slowly opened his eyes, a smile appearing on his face.

The Great Destruction Rule, being a Pillar-level Fusion Rule, the Seventh Realm is already at the twelfth sphere.

However, Lin Yuan had already comprehended this Pillar-level Fusion Rule to the peak of the Sixth Realm at the tenth level.

Now stepping into the Eleventh Level, the rate of comprehension skyrocketed, reaching the Seventh Realm was to be expected.

In fact, over the past three months, reaching the Seventh Realm in Pillar-level Fusion Rules, the Great Destruction Rule was not the first.

The first Pillar-level Fusion Rule that Lin Yuan reached the Seventh Realm was the Life and Death Samsara Rule.

“Hmm?”

“My internal world has expanded again.”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly, his consciousness descended into his internal world.

Stepping into the Eleventh Level caused the Chaos Void Origin Infusion, breaking the shackles limiting Lin Yuan’s internal world.

Although without the boost from the essence of a twelfth level life, Lin Yuan’s internal world cannot reach tens of thousands or hundreds of thousands of light years.

But with no more shackles, every time Lin Yuan improved a step in the rule realm, his internal world noticeably expanded.

Furthermore, as time passed, the internal world continuously absorbed the immersed Chaos Void Origin, also slowly expanding.

However, the speed was too slow, far slower than the fierce expansion caused by the advancement of rule realms.

When he first stepped into the Eleventh Level, Lin Yuan’s internal world reached six hundred billion square miles.

Now, with the comprehension of two Seventh Realm Pillar-level Fusion Rules, Lin Yuan’s internal world has explosively grown to six hundred and fifty billion square miles.

An increase of a full five hundred billion square miles in his internal world.

“With my current level of life essence, I wonder what it would appear like reflected in the river of time?”

Lin Yuan’s thoughts stirred slightly.

A cosmic creature, located within the river of time.

But one can only descend their consciousness into the river of time after fully comprehending the Rule of Time, briefly observing the surroundings.

Any creature has a corresponding form reflected in the river of time.

Normally, the stronger the essence of life, the more enormous the form reflected in the river of time.

Tenth level life forms in the river of time are already considered small fish.

And Eleventh level life forms are regarded as big fish in the river of time.

The stronger the life essence, the larger the body presented in the river of time, capable of venturing deeper into the river of time.

With these thoughts, Lin Yuan’s consciousness swiftly merged into the river of time.

…

A suppressing, narrow breath rushed towards him.

Lin Yuan opened his eyes, looking around.

This is an unimaginable river, vast and boundless, with no end in sight.

However, at this moment, Lin Yuan’s enormous body filled the entire riverbed.

Enormous amounts of river water surged forth, unable to shake Lin Yuan’s body in the slightest.

“Too cramped…”

This thought emerged in Lin Yuan’s mind, the previously vast and expansive river of time now seemed barely able to contain him.

Whoosh.

Lin Yuan’s casually twisting body caused the river water to surge, sweeping towards the shore, causing many ‘big fish’ to retreat in shock, frantically fleeing in other directions.
